title: An Accurate and Single-Communication Federated Inference Algorithm
summary: Joint analyses across multiple institutions are increasingly important in biomedical and epidemiological research, particularly for rare diseases where datasets are typical small. However, privacy regulations and institutional policies often prevent the sharing of individual-level patient data. In this paper we present an accurate and single-communication federated inference algorithm.
